title: BetterFilters
description: GUI-based hopper/chest filters using custom item! Filtering solution for your server!
body:
**BetterFilters** lets you add per‑block item filters to chests and hoppers with a simple admin‑spawned Filter Wand. Set whitelist, blacklist, or both using a GUI. Filters support custom items.
Spigot/Paper 1.18+

Use "/bf wand" to spawn in filter wand
